resources.string: If the address of the NAS changes, the app does not know the new one: it reaches the NAS only at the addresses it is paired with. Open the new address in the browser, sign in and confirm there.
The NAS is not answering right now. That is normal during a trial; the app keeps asking.
The trial time is over. Without confirmation the NAS restores the previous setting; the app keeps asking.
The app does not reach the NAS at the new management address – it only knows the paired addresses. Open the new address in the browser, sign in there and confirm the change.
